description: Technical SEO audit of one page: HTTP status, redirect chain, title and meta description length, H1 count, canonical, robots meta, hreflang, Open Graph and Twitter tags, JSON-LD types, images without alt text, link counts, security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options), technology detection (CMS, framework, analytics, CDN) and a prioritised issue list with a 0-100 score. Static HTML only; honours robots.txt.
name: site_audit
